newsitem.title: USA: Airgas claims supplier commits fraud.
newsitem.headline: Airgas claims supplier commits fraud.

text.p: Airgas Inc said it believes a third party supplier committed fraud and broke a contract that could cost the company up to $23 million.
A company spokesman said the alleged fraud could cost the company $23 million if it is not reimbursed by its insurance carriers and if it does not recover any funds.
"It's a worst case scenario," spokesman James Borum said about the $23 million figure.
Airgas said in an announcement on Monday that it is pursuing various civil and criminal remedies.
Airgas did not disclose the name of the other company.
The contract, which Airgas entered into in late November, related to Airgas's purchase of certain gas products for resale to Airgas's customers, Airgas said.
Airgas said it paid $23 million for products that were not delivered and the small portion of the gas product that was delivered to customers did not meet specifications.
Airgas is not certain about the extent of any charge related to this deal, since it is uncertain about insurance reimbursement or recovery prospects, Borum said.
